tasks.title: WHO WAS STILL THERE
tasks.prompt: How many Team Pulse members appear in the engineering-block activity records after 9:20 PM? Enter the number.
tasks.evidence_label: Team Pulse members active after 9:20 PM: {value}
tasks.explanation: Five Team Pulse members (Nikhil, Sameer, Arjun, Rohit and Kavya) appear in the workshop, equipment and fest activity records after 21:20.
reference_sql: select count(distinct a.person_name) from (select person_name, event_at from workshop_access_log union all select person_name, event_at from fest_activity_log union all select person_name, event_at from equipment_checkout) a join team_members m on m.full_name = a.person_name where m.team_name = 'Team Pulse' and a.event_at >= '2026-10-16 21:20:00'

tasks.title: SEVEN MINUTES LATE
tasks.prompt: After correcting the controller clock, what is the real time Module 04 powered on again? Answer as HH:MM.
tasks.explanation: The controller shows ON at 21:29 and its clock is 3 minutes slow, so the real time is 21:32.
reference_sql: select to_char(p.controller_at - (c.config_value::int * interval '1 minute'), 'HH24:MI') from power_controller_log p cross join security_configuration c where p.component_code = 'MODULE_04' and p.status = 'ON' and c.config_key = 'controller_clock_offset_minutes'
